Hybrid architecture

Key features of the Fractal design North XL Charcoal Black TG Dark computer case

• With tempered glass side panel
  • Real wood front
  • Also accommodates E-ATX format boards
  • A total of three 140 mm Aspect 14 fans
  • Enough space to hide the necessary wiring
  • Dust filters in the front and at the source
Emphasis on quiet operation

The North XL is designed for users looking to build a quiet gaming PC. It offers enough space for E-ATX motherboards, larger graphics cards, and installation of a water cooling radiator up to 413 mm long. Three 140 mm fans are factory-installed, which ensure airflow around key components at low speeds.
Control panel and cooling

The Fractal design North XL case is equipped with 140 mm Aspect 14 fans. All of them are located in the front and draw air into the case through a dust filter. Of course, it is possible to install additional fans, including water cooling. Thanks to this, the components inside the Fractal design PC case are well cooled. In addition to the power button, the control panel also includes connectors for headphones and a microphone. However, USB 3.2 Gen 1 and USB-C are much more important.
